message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of an agent workflow for creating reusable tools and feeding them back into an iterative loop.","description":"A workflow diagram is enclosed by a gray dashed, clockwise loop labeled “CodeReAct Loop”: the top edge points right, the right edge points down, the bottom edge points left, and the left edge points up. A plug-like icon sits at the upper left, a list/server-like icon at the upper right, an ellipsis bubble at the lower left, and a crossed-tools-like icon at the lower right; these small icons have no individual labels. At the top, a red-bordered “Question” box, illustrated with a person and document/question symbols plus a circled X, has a red arrow pointing down to a cloud labeled “Manager Agent.” To the manager’s left, a cloud labeled “Web Agent” is joined to it by a blue two-way arrow. A short gray connector runs from the Manager Agent to a large rounded panel labeled “MCP Creation”; no clear arrowhead is visible on this connector. Inside the MCP Creation panel, a pink “MCP Brainstorming” block contains wrench/circuit imagery and a light bulb. A magenta arrow points right from this block to a yellow panel listing three operations vertically: “Open-source Searching,” “Script Generating,” and “Virtual Env Execution,” with search, code/pencil, and code/play symbols. A yellow right-pointing arrow leads from this panel to a package-and-cubes icon labeled “Encapsulate,” followed by a gray right-pointing arrow into a purple cloud labeled “MCP Box,” illustrated as a toolbox holding tools. From the MCP Box, a purple feedback path runs left beneath the panels and bends upward, with its arrow entering the Manager Agent; the path is labeled “Self Evolving.” A green arrow points down from the Manager Agent to a green “Output” box, illustrated with a person and an orange circled check mark.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
